vector_memory.semantic_summary: CubePrimitive is a concrete implementation of MeshData designed to procedurally generate the geometry for a standard cube. It calculates and populates arrays for vertices, normals, UV coordinates, and indices based on a specified size parameter. The class utilizes a private helper function, addFace, to systematically construct the six faces of the cube by defining two triangles per face. It serves as a fundamental, ready-to-use geometry data model within the rendering pipeline.
